messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: spike in 401s from edge-proxy eu-west-1 (inc-18177). Possible leakage in debug pipeline. Auto-created thread.
oncall-anna: got it, I'm taking it. switching to incident channel. tagging sec-eng-omar and infra-li.
oncall-anna: quick ask — any customer-facing errors reported yet?
cust-success-maya: one customer reported increased auth failures in EU; CS ticket #8421 opened. No data exfil report yet.
sec-eng-omar: joining. initial glance at proxy logs shows repeated requests with truncated auth headers then 401s from same client IP cluster. suspicious.
infra-li: looking at log-forwarder. pipeline shows a recent debug deploy 02:12 UTC that enabled full headers in debug stream to indexer-staging.
sec-eng-omar: that matches — indexer-staging has a recent s3 upload around 02:13 with small blobs. I'm pulling the object list now.
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.runbook/incident/auth-leak. Recommended steps: isolate indexer-staging, snapshot S3 objects, rotate affected keys.
oncall-anna: @infra-li please isolate indexer-staging from external indexer consumers and suspend log-forwarder.
infra-li: isolating now. command: `kubectl scale deployment/log-forwarder -n observability --replicas=0`
infra-li: forwarder replicas 0 -> suspended. S3 ingestion paused.
sec-eng-omar: pulled 3 small objects. They contain debug traces with short-lived service session tokens (bearer tokens) and tenant ids. Tokens appear to be ephemeral but could be used within 10m window.
oncall-anna: escalate to legal and CS. @legal-sam please standby for potential customer notification decision.
legal-sam: standing by. need scope: which tenants affected and whether tokens allow access to PII.
cust-success-maya: I can map tenant ids to customers. sharing list to sec-eng-omar via DM, will prepare comms if needed.
sec-eng-omar: quick risk assessment: tokens are service-session tokens with limited scope (read-only) and TTL ~15m. No sign of successful usage from outside our infra after ingestion pause. Low-to-medium risk but treat as sensitive.
oncall-anna: action list: 1) rotate affected service tokens 2) schedule KMS key rewrap for related keys 3) notify impacted customers if scope > read-only or tokens used externally.
sec-eng-omar: starting token rotate for service accounts tied to forwarder. cmd (internal): `scripts/rotate_service_tokens --service log-forwarder --dry-run=false`
infra-li: prepping KMS key rewrap. will schedule rewrap + new encryption context. ETA 8m.
sec-eng-omar: running quick detection to see any outbound auth calls using those tokens: `grep -R "svc-tok-" /var/log/proxy/* | tail -n 200`
sec-eng-omar: doing token invalidation via auth service: `POST /internal/admin/invalidate_tokens {tokens:[...]} ` — invalidation confirmed.
ops-bot: Pager update: mitigation steps in progress. Status: containment.
noncall-anna: any sign of exfil beyond indexer-staging s3?
sec-eng-omar: negative so far — no external IPs pulled objects. Access logs show only internal service agents.
cust-success-maya: prepping message draft: "We detected debug logs containing short-lived tokens from our staging indexer. We have isolated the pipeline, rotated tokens, and are investigating. No evidence of customer data misuse." Will share for review.
legal-sam: review incoming. If tokens had wider scope need to send urgent notification. For now hold to "investigating" language.
noncall-anna: after token rotate and KMS rewrap, we'll run a sweep for token reuse and then close. Assigning follow-ups: sec-eng-omar (forensics), infra-li (reconfig + deploy hotfix to disable header dumping), cust-success-maya (customer comms draft), legal-sam (notification trigger decision).
infra-li: hotfix prepared to strip `Authorization` header from debug streams. patch: `observability: drop_headers: [Authorization]` applying to config and will rollout canary.
infra-li: canary rolled to 2 nodes in eu-west-1. no regressions. rolling to full cluster.
sec-eng-omar: forensics: pulled object snapshots to secure bucket `s3://sec-archive/1817712345/`. checksumed and locked.
oncall-anna: KMS rewrap done?
infra-li: rewrap complete, new key id: key-0x8a7c. rotated service account keys listed in rot-log-1817.
ops-bot: Automated note: incident timeline updated in ticket inc-18177.
sec-eng-omar: post-rotate scan shows no reuse of tokens and no external GET on those objects.
cust-success-maya: customer comms ready, legal approved wording: light-touch notification telling impacted customers actions taken. Sending now to affected customers.
legal-sam: confirm we are not declaring a breach. continue monitoring 24h, file internal report.
noncall-anna: status update: mitigated — pipeline isolated, forwarder disabled, tokens rotated, KMS rewrap complete, hotfix deployed to drop auth headers. Monitoring for 24h.
noncall-anna: closing in 1h pending no anomalies. good work team. :thumbsup:
